reason: Bash calls in this environment are auto-rewritten by an RTK hook after the auto-mode classifier reviews them. The classifier then refuses the call because the reviewed input differs from what runs, and it tells the agent to re-send the identical input, which is refused again. The agent lost several calls to this loop. Issuing the rewritten command directly was accepted. This is a recurring environment behaviour, so it belongs in a skill that the next session finds by the error text.
